The durable change is minor because it adds four optional recovery tables and additive usage columns with idempotent forward migration; existing business rows and old reader paths remain untouched.

scope_drift.description: The candidate adds only optional public recovery diagnostics and a coded unavailable body, plus additive durable checkpoint/staging tables and usage columns. Healthy response fields remain compatible, older readers can ignore the new tables/columns, and the recovery path narrows claims until exact publication rather than returning approximations.

current.reasoning: Healthy responses retain their previous fields, while the optional system-status recovery object and coded 503 body are additive. Supported earlier same-Minor readers can ignore the new recovery tables/columns. Dashboard day-window staging is generation-fenced, idempotent, tuple-cursor based, and fail-closed until exact publication; the 10,000 journal retention bound is not used as a full-table admission gate. A complete recovery turn covers its durable reads, bounded state writes, rollback/close cleanup, and publication deadline, and candidate/source reads plus publication use dedicated SQLite connections with deadline-aligned busy timeouts, progress handlers, and bounded close paths. The materialization budget covers only loaded projection text, so raw payload is not staged or charged. The in-memory snapshot is exposed only after the publication commit.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing consumers of the StatsResponse and SystemStatus JSON contracts, including supported earlier same-Minor clients; healthy payloads retain the prior shape, while coded unavailable responses and recovery status are additive.

persistent_state.state_description: The main SQLite database gains the existing optimizer/repair state plus additive Dashboard compacted-source checkpoint, aggregate, usage, and bounded record-identity tables. Dashboard recovery stores fixed Shanghai day-window boundaries, a tuple cursor, processed rows, target generation-fence values, normalized aggregates, usage breakdowns, and list-limited identities; it does not copy payloads. A durable cursor compare-and-swap prevents concurrent page double counting, coverage-fence changes discard unpublishable staging, and append-only live-tail changes are served through exact bounded deltas. Recovery state transitions use a bounded connection and remaining worker-turn deadline, so contention defers rather than extending the recovery turn. NULL or blank replay-marker SHA values fail closed, stale markers re-enter repair, and non-error source text over the materialization budget fails closed. All new state is idempotent and forward-repairable; no allocator writeback, backup copy, destructive cleanup, or deployment state is introduced.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Supported earlier same-Minor readers can ignore the additive Dashboard recovery tables/columns and continue using existing archive_batches, hourly_rollup_archive_replay, and invocation_rollup_hourly representations.
